newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON KEY U.S. UNIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON KEY U.S. UNIT.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer against the key U.S. dollar at the close of Thursday interbank trade on the back of increased demand for that currency, dealers said.

"Someone was buying U.S. dollars like nobody's business in the market...I'm not sure what transactions they were financing. The central bank came in, but only with little bits and pieces,' one dealer said.
The local unit ended the day at 10.3625/3825 against the U.S. dollar, down from 10.3400/3600 at Wednesday's close.

On the crosses, it was also quoted softer on pound sterling at 16.2140/2540 from 16.1930/2340 overnight but was firmer at 6.7670/7820 versus the German mark compared with 6.7810/7960 the previous day.
Against the rand, the Zimbabwe dollar finished at 2.2880/2940, up from 2.2930/2990.
